malaclaw.note: Raised from >=1.0.2. Compiled manifests now require the foreach command-template fix; on 1.0.2 every study execution receives a literal {{item.id}} and fails.

sdk.note: The SDK ships as the ./sdk subpath export of the malaclaw package, not as a separate @malaclaw/sdk. It imports the engine's canonical Zod IR, so splitting it out would either duplicate that schema or load two zod instances. MrMaLiang resolves it from the checked-out runtime at .dependencies/MalaClaw.
